subject.title: feat(ui): who's-online roster menu on the footer facepile

question: Should the footer roster expose every online user's email to all Control UI users who can open the sidebar footer menu, or should it show only fields allowed by the existing profile/presence visibility policy?
rationale: The patch intentionally adds a new personally identifying-data display surface, but the available review material does not establish the authorization scope of the presence payload or a policy permitting this broader presentation.

options.title: Constrain roster identity fields
options.body: Use the existing profile/presence visibility policy and omit email subtitles unless the viewer is explicitly authorized to see them.

options.title: Accept email visibility
options.body: Confirm that every user with access to this footer is authorized to see all online participants' email addresses and retain the current rendering.

options.title: Pause the roster change
options.body: Defer this feature until the intended Control UI identity-disclosure contract is documented or implemented.

recommendation.title: Constrain roster identity fields
recommendation.body: Use the existing profile/presence visibility policy and omit email subtitles unless the viewer is explicitly authorized to see them.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history makes this account the best available contact for the feature's intended identity presentation.
